name: Lamball
title: Big Floof
description: A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom of the food chain itself.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Shield
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield.
Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

name: Cattiva
title: The Cat's Pajamas
description: At a glance it appears confident, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

partnerSkill.name: Cat Helper
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity by 100 - 200. (Does not stack)

name: Chikipi
title: Plump & Juicy
description: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside Lamball. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

partnerSkill.name: Egg Layer
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to the ranch.

name: Lifmunk
title: Coward of the Steppe
description: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

partnerSkill.name: Lifmunk Recoil
partnerSkill.description: When activated, leaps onto the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follow up the player attacks.

name: Fuack
title: Rowdy Wave Ripper
description: Using its own body water, this pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.

partnerSkill.name: Surfing Slam
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.

name: Fuack Ignis
title: Runaway Wave Rider
description: With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs. But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.

partnerSkill.name: Fire Tackle
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Fuack Ignis fire surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.

name: Vixy
title: Star of the Steppe
description: The idol of Palpagos Islands. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

partnerSkill.name: Dig Here!
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch.

name: Celaray
title: Soaring Skyfish
description: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end.

partnerSkill.name: Zephyr Glider
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider.
Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

name: Celaray Lux
title: Sky-Swimming Fish
description: Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celeray Lux, yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Glider
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider.
Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

name: Cremis
title: Darling Furball
description: Compared to Lamball, it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically always been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Wool
partnerSkill.description:
While in team, increases Attack of  Neutral Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack)
Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

name: Croajiro
title: Harakiri Master
description: Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.

partnerSkill.name: Leap Stance
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Croajiro channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air.
While airborne, the player's Attack is increased by 50% - 86%.

name: Croajiro Noct
title: Natural Born Killer
description: The Croajiro who have fosaken their honor gather and form splinter groups. They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey. If you encounter a pack of Croajiro Noct in the dead of the night, it's your life that's on the line.

partnerSkill.name: Shadow Stance
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air.
While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals'  Dark attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by 25% - 40. (Does not stack)

name: Herbil
title: Percussive Maintenance
description: When in doubt, punch it till it works—that's Herbil's approach to fixing things. With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.

partnerSkill.name: Herbil Pulse
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Herbil uses its healing powers to restore 30% - 60% of the player's Max Health when incapacitated.

name: Teafant
title: Adorable Watering Can
description: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

partnerSkill.name: Soothing Shower
partnerSkill.description: While in party, restores 20% - 40% of the player's Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) (120-second cooldown after activation)

name: Gumoss
title: Suddenly Transformed
description: A strange pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.

partnerSkill.name: Logging Assistance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves logging efficiency by (30%-50%) and reduces weight of all types of wood by 40% - 60%. (Does not stack)

name: Pupperai
title: Zealous
description: Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to "stay" is risky business, as the "go" command triggers that same attack instinct.

partnerSkill.name: Best Boy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by 10% - 35%. (Does not stack)

name: Clovee
title: Dubiously Lucky
description: Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.

partnerSkill.name: Happy Clover
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Gathering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

name: Jolthog
title: Don't Touch!
description: It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack. The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips Jolthog to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an  Electric explosion upon impact.

name: Jolthog Cryst
title: Watch Your Feet!
description: It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

partnerSkill.name: Cold Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips Jolthog Cryst to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an  Ice explosion upon impact.

name: Depresso
title: Several Sleepless Nights Later
description: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.

partnerSkill.name: Caffeine Inoculation
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Depresso chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by 100% - 900%.
Sometimes drops Venom Gland when assigned to Ranch.

name: Pengullet
title: Ate Too Much
description: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Launcher
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire Pengullet as ammunition.
Pengullet explodes on contact and is incapacitated.

name: Pengullet Lux
title: Had One Too Many
description: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly. Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy- so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Lux Launcher
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher and fires Pengullet Lux as ammunition.
Pengullet Lux explodes on impact and is incapacitated.

name: Penking
title: Pioneer of the Frozen Sea
description: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet. However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.

partnerSkill.name: Brave Sailor
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  Fire Pals drop 40% - 80% more items when defeated.

name: Penking Lux
title: Pioneer of the Black
description: Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting. As a result, it lost the affection of Pengullet- but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower: Pengullet Lux.

partnerSkill.name: Unyielding Storm Commander
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals'  Water attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by 25% - 40%. (Does not stack)

name: Hoocrates
title: Purveyor of Wisdom
description: Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. "I think, therefore I am."

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knowledge
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of  Dark Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack)

name: Melpaca
title: Pompous Shanks
description: Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.

partnerSkill.name: Pacapaca Wool
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
While in party, increases Kingpaca's Defense and Movement Speed.
Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

name: Kingpaca
title: Supreme Fluff Commander
description: Melpaca serve this pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

partnerSkill.name: King of Muscles
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by 5% - 14% for every Melpaca in the party.

name: Kingpaca Cryst
title: Azure Fluff Commander
description: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca.

partnerSkill.name: King of Muscles
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by 5% - 14% for each Melpaca in the party.

name: Daedream
title: Dream Eater
description: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

partnerSkill.name: Dream Chaser
partnerSkill.description:
While in team, appears near the player.
Attacks hostile enemies with  Dark magic bullets.
These bullets will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

name: Tanzee
title: Dexterous Primate
description: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns.

partnerSkill.name: Cheery Rifle
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

name: Tanzee Ignis
title: Flame Aficionado
description: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.

partnerSkill.name: Chipper Chimp Gunfire
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Tanzee Ignis will mercilessly fire a  Fire assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

name: Nox
title: Dusken Aristocrat
description: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.

partnerSkill.name: Kuudere
partnerSkill.description: When activated, detects the location of nearby Pal Effigies.

name: Flambelle
title: Molten Daughter
description: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Tears
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by 0.1% - 0.5% per second outside of combat. (Does not stack)
Sometimes produces Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

name: Rooby
title: Chief of the Herd
description: Wild Rooby surprisingly never gets sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.

partnerSkill.name: Tiny Spark
partnerSkill.description:
While in team, increases Defense of  Fire Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack)
Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

name: Mau
title: Noble Glimmer
description: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails to bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who where poached as a result, they were anything but.

partnerSkill.name: Gold Digger
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to the ranch.

name: Mau Cryst
title: Serene Glimmer
description: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Whispers
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch.

name: Rushoar
title: Woodland Ruffian
description: Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength. Though small, its powerful charge can send even boulders flying.

partnerSkill.name: Hard Head
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
While mounted, increases efficiency of destroying Stone by 500% - 2,000%.

name: Foxparks
title: Revealer of Paths
description: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Fire
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower.

name: Foxparks Cryst
title: Icy Blossom Voyager
description: It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Frost
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and attacks using frigid air.

name: Killamari
title: Emotionless
description: It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Squid
partnerSkill.description:
While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider.
Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

name: Killamari Primo
title: Devoid of Emotion
description: It sinks its fangs into the enemy's neck, draining every last drop of blood. When two Killamari Primos latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle-each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Killamari
partnerSkill.description:
While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider.
Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

name: Fuddler
title: Underground Explorer
description: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.

partnerSkill.name: Mining Assistance
partnerSkill.description: When in party, improves player mining efficiency by 30% - 60% and reduces Stone weight by 80% - 100%. (Does not stack)

name: Eikthyrdeer
title: Protector of the Herd
description: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Forest
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
Can perform a double jump while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by 220% - 500%.

name: Eikthyrdeer Terra
title: Antler of Gold
description: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Golden Forest
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
Can perform a double jump while mounted.
While at a base, increases the Lumbering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

name: Direhowl
title: Hunter of the Steppe
description: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.

partnerSkill.name: Direhowl Rider
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
Moves slightly faster than most mounts.

name: Caprity
title: Walking Farm
description: The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

partnerSkill.name: Berry Picker
partnerSkill.description:
Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to Ranch.
While in party, restores 100 - 200 Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

name: Caprity Noct
title: Tainted Farm
description: The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love.

partnerSkill.name: Venom Picker
partnerSkill.description:
Sometimes drops Venom Gland from its back when assigned to Ranch.
While in party, restores 100 - 200 Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

name: Swee
title: Curious Floof
description: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack and Defense of Sweepa.

name: Sweepa
title: King of the Floof
description: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.

partnerSkill.name: King of Fluff
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by 12% - 24% for each Swee in party.

name: Turtacle
title: Mini Fortress
description: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.

partnerSkill.name: Spikey Carrier
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces weight of the item Ore by 80% - 100%. (Does not stack)

name: Turtacle Terra
title: Golden Fortress
description:
To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.}} Turtacle Terra (Japanese: ゴルメッコ Golmekko) is the {{Icon|Water}} / Ground-element subspecies of {{Icon|Turtacle}}. Turtacle Terra is largely identical to the regular Turtacle, save for the fact that it has a golden shell. 

==Obtaining==

|-|Habitat=
Turtacle Terra can be found in the western shores of Mount Obsidian and the Southern Sandbar of Sakurajima.

A group of Turtacle Terra can also show up as a raiding party to the player's base in the Desert Region, occasionally accompanied by Tocotoco, Robinquill Terra, or Gorirat Terra.

Turtacle Terra can also be found caged in a Moonflower Clan camp near the Feybreak Shipwreck.

Turtacle Terra can be {{Icon|Fishing|fished}} up around the saltwater of Desiccated Dunes and Sandstone Gate Islet, as well as in the Eternal Summer Isle and Oasis Isle.
|-|Alpha (Overworld)=
There is no {{Icon|Alpha Pals|Alpha}} Turtacle Terra boss in the overworld.

partnerSkill.name: Shiny Hauler
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, reduces weight of Sulfur and Coal by 80% - 100%.
Also increases damage dealt by Player and Pals'  Ground attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by 25% - 40%. (Does not stack)

name: Hangyu
title: Bringer of Luck
description: Its strong arms can rip apart even iron. As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Hangyu would tear the skin right from their bones.

partnerSkill.name: Flying Trapeze
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider.
Enables slow ascension while gliding.

name: Hangyu Cryst
title: Glacial Harbinger
description: Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice. There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square and had their hair torn out by Hangyu Cryst as a brutal form of public humiliation.

partnerSkill.name: Winter Trapeze
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider.
Enables slow ascension while gliding.

name: Woolipop
title: Giant Cotton Candy
description: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Candy Pop
partnerSkill.description:
Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch.
While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -10% - -20%. (Does not stack)

name: Woolipop Terra
title: King-Sized Confection
description: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.

partnerSkill.name: Bitter Pop
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Caramel Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -15% - -25%. (Does not stack)

name: Mozzarina
title: Grade A Beef
description: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

partnerSkill.name: Milk Maker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Milk when assigned to Ranch.

name: Azurobe
title: Lady of the Lake
description: This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity.

partnerSkill.name: Waterwing Dance
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water.
While mounted, changes the player's attack type to  Water and increases Attack by 5% - 20%.

name: Azurobe Cryst
title: Lady of the Frozen Lake
description: This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Icewing Dance
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water.
 While mounted, changes the player's attack type to  Ice and increases Attack by 5% - 20%.

name: Sparkit
title: Livewire Tabby
description: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.

partnerSkill.name: Static Electricity
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases Attack of  Electric Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack.)
Sometimes drops Electric Organ when assigned to Ranch.

name: Kelpsea
title: Child of the Deep
description: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

partnerSkill.name: Aqua Spout
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases Attack of  Water Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack)
Sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids when assigned to Ranch.

name: Kelpsea Ignis
title: Child of Molten Depths
description: Its personality changes depending on the temperature of the water it was born in. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.

partnerSkill.name: Lava Spout
partnerSkill.description:
While in team, increases Attack of  Fire Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack)
Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

name: Ribbuny
title: Heart-Melting Smile
description: A Pal that's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva's pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic.

partnerSkill.name: Happy-Go-Lucky Bunny
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases Attack of  Neutral Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack).
While at a base, increases the Handiwork Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

name: Ribbuny Botan
title: Sparkling Smile
description: Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva's pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.

partnerSkill.name: Ground 'n' Pound
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals'  Grass attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by 25% - 40%. (Does not stack)
Increases efficiency by 200% - 400% when working at a Weapon Workbench, Weapon Assembly Line, or other related facilities.

name: Jelliette
title: Sunlight Drifter
description: A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy. It’s very social, so when plans overlap, it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date.

partnerSkill.name: Jelliette Drop
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases items obtained from fishing by 55% - 95%.
While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jelliette's watering speed increases by 50% - 120%. (Does not stack)

name: Jellroy
title: Shade Drifter
description: A Pal that closely resembles Jelliette. It sometimes appears as a substitute when Jelliette is unavailable. Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.

partnerSkill.name: Jellroy Drop
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases items obtained from salvaging by 55% - 95%.
While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jellroy's watering speed increases by 50% - 120%. (Does not stack)

name: Amione
title: Miraculously Close
description: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione, companionship is everything.

partnerSkill.name: Magical Twin Powers
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Watering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

name: Gloopie
title: Trickster of the Sea
description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly awkward misunderstandings.

partnerSkill.name: Sticky Princess
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the capture gauge decreases 12% - 35% more slowly while the bars are not overlapping during the fishing minigame. (Does not stack)

name: Gloopie Primo
title: Everyday Trickster
description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly unnecessary concern.

partnerSkill.name: Cephalo-Princess
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of  Water Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack)

name: Galeclaw
title: Proud Courier
description: A pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

partnerSkill.name: Galeclaw Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand.

name: Wispaw
title: Adorable Phantom Thief
description: The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw.

partnerSkill.name: Death-Cheating Feline
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate when awarded a back bonus. (Does not stack)

name: Nitewing
title: Wings of the Firmament
description: It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.

partnerSkill.name: Travel Companion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.

name: Tombat
title: Trickster
description: Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.

partnerSkill.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
partnerSkill.description: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap.

name: Tocotoco
title: Boom or Bust
description: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.

partnerSkill.name: Eggbomb Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher.

name: Univolt
title: Swift Deity
description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Deity
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
 While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals'  Electric attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by 25% - 40%. (Does not stack)

name: Univolt Cryst
title: Blustery Blizzard Fiend
description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Frigid Deity
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
While mounted, changes the player's attack type to  Ice and increases Attack by 5% - 20%.

name: Gobfin
title: Sea Thug
description: Long ago, it was a large and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food become scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Aqua Gun.
When this Pal uses Aqua Gun, it has a x1.1 - x2.5 damage multiplier.
While in party, increases the player's Attack by 10% - 20%.

name: Gobfin Ignis
title: Volcano Thug
description: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Spirit Fire.
When this Pal uses Spirit Fire, it has a x1.1 - x2.5 damage multiplier.
While in party, increases the player's Attack by 10% - 20%.

name: Loupmoon
title: Enraptured by Moonlight
description: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Jumping Claw.
When this Pal uses Jumping Claw, it has a x1.1 - x2.5 damage multiplier.
While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack)

name: Loupmoon Cryst
title: Enraptured by the Frozen Moonlight
description: The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts. Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite, but both the one who tries it and Loupmoon Cryst end up with a headache.

partnerSkill.name: Frozen Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Snow Claw.
When this Pal uses Snow Claw, it has a x1.1 - x2.5 damage multiplier.
While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by15% - 30%. (Does not stack)

name: Cawgnito
title: Shadow-Cloaked Schemer
description: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.

partnerSkill.name: Eerie Nightstreaker
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, grants Night Vision to see in dark places. Activate again to turn off.
Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch.

name: Arsox
title: Blazing Brute
description: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Warm Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains Cold Resistance +2. (Does not stack)

name: Muffly
title: Totally Toasty
description: Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Flutterer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Freeze. (Does not stack)

name: Bristla
title: Thorny Rose
description: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles when a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.

partnerSkill.name: Princess Gaze
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of  Grass Pals by 15% - 30%. (Does not stack)

name: Cinnamoth
title: Butterfly Promenade
description: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.

partnerSkill.name: Mysterious Scales
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Poison Fog. While at a base, increases the Farming Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

name: Puffolt
title: Sulky Static
description: Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked. Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble.

partnerSkill.name: Crackle Booster
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Generating Electricity Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals. (Does not stack)

name: Elphidran
title: Gentle Sky Dragon
description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Holy Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. While fighting together, Dark Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Elphidran Aqua
title: Beast of the Tides
description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Water Dragon
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. 


While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less  Fire damage and are immune to Burn. (Does not stack)

name: Vanwyrm
title: Aerial Marauder
description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount. 

While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 30%. (Does not stack)

name: Vanwyrm Cryst
title: Marauder of Frozen Skies
description: The melodies of a flute made from an exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountains ranges. In ages past, such flutes where used to signal victory in battle.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount. 

While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 30%. (Does not stack)

name: Felbat
title: Gloom-Shrouded Bloodsucker
description: Attacking from the shadows, this pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wigs. It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.

partnerSkill.name: Life Steal
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Felbat the life steal effect which absorbs some of the received damage and restores Health.

name: Vaelet
title: Voice of the Violets
description: The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared. - From the fairy tale, "The King's Flower."

partnerSkill.name: Purification of Gaia
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Ground Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Beegarde
title: Guardian Commander
description: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee. Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

partnerSkill.name: Worker Bee
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Elizabee's Attack. Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch.

name: Elizabee
title: Empress of the Hive
description: A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.

partnerSkill.name: Queen Bee Command
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, stats will increase the more Beegarde are in your team.

name: Lovander
title: Pal on the Prowl
description: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

partnerSkill.name: Heart Drain
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Lovander a life steal effect that restores 5% of damage dealth as Health..

name: Grintale
title: Marshmallow Body
description: Grintale's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech - its eyes literally light up.

partnerSkill.name: Glaring Cat's Eye
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, picking up a Pal Egg has a 50% chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)

name: Tarantriss
title: Tactician of the Thread Realm
description:
Extremely sticky and clingy.
 The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes.
 Such is its "personality."

partnerSkill.name: Tarantriss’ Web
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Additionally, can shoot spider silk to grapple and move at fast speed.

name: Polapup
title: Idol on Ice
description: Among Polapups, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season. Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapups.

partnerSkill.name: Rider of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  Runs faster over snow. Can slide quickly down slopes.

name: Polapup Terra
title: Star of the Dunes
description: Among Polapup Terras, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow— a common sight during particularly competitive seasons. Traffic forecast: heavy Polapup Terra congestion.

partnerSkill.name: Snowy Mountain Slider
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by (80~160)% while mounted on snow. Can also slide quickly down slopes. While it starts out slow, the top speed it can hit while sliding is no joke.

name: Leezpunk
title: Self-Proclaimed Genius
description: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.

partnerSkill.name: Sixth Sense
partnerSkill.description: When activated, utilizes its sixth sense to detect nearby dungeons.

name: Leezpunk Ignis
title: Self-Proclaimed Fashionista
description: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

partnerSkill.name: Sixth Sense
partnerSkill.description: When activated, utilizes its sixth sense to detect nearby dungeons.

name: Gorirat
title: Jungle Punk
description: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat's Attack by 75% for a limited time.

name: Gorirat Terra
title: Up for a Brawl
description: It communicates with its friends through rhythmic tapping on the ground. Stronger than Gorirat. If every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Mode
partnerSkill.description:
While in party,
increases the player's climbing speed by 50-100%. (Does not stack)

name: Surfent
title: The Ocean's Wrath
description: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited to life in water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Swimmer
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water. 

Sometimes drops Leather when assigned to Ranch.

name: Surfent Terra
title: The Desert's Wrath
description: Its aerodynamic form is well suited to life on the sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Swimmer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Surfent Terra helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of ores in the player's inventory.

name: Robinquill
title: Archer of the Forest
description: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans so long ago.

partnerSkill.name: Grounded Archer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's bow damage.

name: Robinquill Terra
title: Archer of the Sands
description: A Pal that lives a hunting life in rocky areas and is very close to humans. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.

partnerSkill.name: Hawk Eye
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, allows you to deal more damage to weak points.

name: Flopie
title: Star of the Flower Beds
description: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.

partnerSkill.name: Helper Bunny
partnerSkill.description: While in team, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

name: Wixen
title: Fire Licked Furball
description: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. it prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress.

partnerSkill.name: Lord Fox
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Fire.

name: Wixen Noct
title: Phantasmal Furball
description: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. Not on good terms with Katress Ignis.

partnerSkill.name: Black Fox Lord
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Dark.

name: Katress
title: Phantasmal Feline
description: With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen.

partnerSkill.name: Mystical Black Magic
partnerSkill.description:
While in party,  Neutral Pals drop 40% - 80% more items when defeated.

 Also has a 10% - 50% chance to prevent Pal Sphere consumption when thrown. (Does not stack)

name: Katress Ignis
title: Fire Licked Feline
description: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. Not on good terms with Wixen Noct.

partnerSkill.name: Blazing Black magic
partnerSkill.description: While at base, increase the Kinding Work Suitabilty Level for all othe Base Pals by +1

name: Helzephyr
title: Wings of The Underworld
description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. One who dies from Helzephyr's inferno is sure to be sent to the underworld.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Death
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Dark while mounted.

name: Helzephyr Lux
title: Wings of Netherstorm
description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. While considered a subspecies of Helzephyr, there's a theory that suggests Helzephyr Lux, struck by lightning from hell, will transform into Helzephyr.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Thunder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Electric while mounted.

name: Elgrove
title: Verdant Minotaur
description: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.

partnerSkill.name: Mother Nature's Menace
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Elgrove changes the player's attack type to  Grass and increases Attack.

name: Elgrove Cryst
title: Frozen Minotaur
description: Its frozen horn stays solid through its life. When water begins to drip from this ice, Elgrove Cryst feels the chill of its own life slipping away.

partnerSkill.name: Father Winter's Threat
partnerSkill.description: While in party, grants the player the ability to Freeze enemies afflicted with Soak in one strike.

name: Lunaris
title: Extraterrestrial
description: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.

partnerSkill.name: Antigravity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, spheres home in on Pals, and carrying capacity increases by 300. (Does not stack)

name: Fenglope
title: Drifting Cloud
description: In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelts and antlers where often seen in works of art.

partnerSkill.name: Wind and Clouds
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

name: Fenglope Lux
title: Drifting Thundercloud
description: In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of Fenglope Lux would result in being struck down by lightning. As time passes, artworks depicting Fenglope Lux became revered as charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.

partnerSkill.name: Stormcloud
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. While fighting together, Water Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Dinossom
title: Guardian of Blossoming Gardens
description: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase "step on a Dinossom's tail" has come to mean enraging someone.

partnerSkill.name: Fragrant Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Grass attacks while mounted.

name: Dinossom Lux
title: Guardian of Lightning
description: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase "struck by a Dinossom Lux's bolt" has come to mean narrowly escaping death.

partnerSkill.name: Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Electric attacks while mounted.

name: Bushi
title: Vagrant Warrior
description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.

partnerSkill.name: Brandish Blade
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Iaigiri.

name: Bushi Noct
title: Samurai of Darkness
description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart, the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders.

partnerSkill.name: Void Blade
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Iaigiri.

When this Pal uses Iaigiri, it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.

While in party,
increases the player's melee weapon damage by 30% but only when not in combat. (Does not stack)

name: Munchill
title: Walking Refrigerator
description:
The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed. Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans—whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.}} Munchill (Japanese: コチワニ Kochiwani) is an {{I|Ice}} / Water-element Pal. Munchill is a small, quadrupedal reptilian Pal with a round body and four stubby legs. It has a white lower body and a light blue upper body, with diamond-shaped pale blue markings on its upper body along with two small blue spikes on top of it. Munchill also has a large mouth with two icy teeth on its lower jaw.

Munchill can be found on the Frostbitten Isle.
