partnerSkill.name: Icy Maw
partnerSkill.description: While in team, Munchill cools ingredients inside its mouth, making the food in your inventory less likely to spoil.

name: Mammorest
title: King of the Forest
description: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.

partnerSkill.name: Gaia Crusher
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of cutting trees and mining ores while mounted.

name: Mammorest Cryst
title: Frozen King
description: The vegetation on its back varies from individual to individual. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Crusher
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of cutting trees and mining ores while mounted.

name: Finsider
title: Eyes from the Abyss
description: It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. Perhaps the universe itself lies within.

partnerSkill.name: Echo Chamber
partnerSkill.description: While in team, Finsider helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of weapons in the player's inventory.

name: Finsider Ignis
title: Eyes from the Flames
description: Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going. Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher tried climbing in like a sleeping bag. But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.

partnerSkill.name: Ember Chamber
partnerSkill.description: While in team,  Finsider Ignis helps carry supplies,  decreasing the weight of weapons  in the player's inventory.  Also increases Attack of Fire Pals.

name: Petallia
title: Lady of the Flower Garden
description: A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by 75%.


While at a base, increases the Planting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

name: Petallia Ignis
title: Lady of the Ashen Wastes
description: A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.

partnerSkill.name: Passion of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.description: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by (80~90)%. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less  Grass damage, and are immune to Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)

name: Leafan
title: Hardcore Heartbreaker
description: To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way! Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way! The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is! The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is!

partnerSkill.name: Selfless Discipline
partnerSkill.description: This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by 2% for each other  Grass Pal in your party.

name: Incineram
title: Hyena of the Wild
description: In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.

partnerSkill.name: Flameclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Hellfire Claw.

name: Incineram Noct
title: Hyena of the Darkest Night
description: It specifically targets baby pals, taking them back to its territory. One can only imagine the profound despair of the parent Pal, whose child has been taken away.

partnerSkill.name: Darkclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Hellfire Claw.

name: Dazzi
title: Born of the Storm
description: Often kind to lonely pals. However, the moment a pal mistakes this for actual companionship it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in team, appears near the player. Follows up player attacks with lightning bolts.

name: Dazzi Noct
title: Born of the Thunderclouds
description: Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Dark Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in team, appears near the player. Follows up player attacks with dark lightning bolts.

name: Pyrin
title: Steed of Flames
description: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. When someone has mounted it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

partnerSkill.name: Red Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Fire while mounted.

name: Pyrin Noct
title: Steed of Darkness
description: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Hare
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden. 
While mounted, changes the player's attack to  Dark and increases Attack by 5%

name: Relaxaurus
title: Gluttonous Dragon
description: Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.

partnerSkill.name: Hungry Missile
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

name: Relaxaurus Lux
title: Gluttonous Thunder Dragon
description: One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!

partnerSkill.name: Missile Party
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

name: Foxcicle
title: Claws of Ice
description: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

partnerSkill.name: Aurora Guide
partnerSkill.description: While in team, increases Attack of Ice Pals. Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to the ranch.

name: Beakon
title: Wings of Thunderbolt
description: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk, but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.

partnerSkill.name: Thunderous
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Electric while mounted.

name: Beakon Cryst
title: Wings of Frost
description: Perfectly adapted to colder environments, it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form. Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky.

partnerSkill.name: Coldsnap
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to  Ice and increases Attack by (5~20)%. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other  Ice Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon Cryst)

name: Ghangler
title: Temptation in the Deep
description: With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness. The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape once spotted by Ghangler. No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home safe and sound.

partnerSkill.name: Master Night Angler
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel quickly across water. While fighting together, the time it takes for Pals to bite during night fishing is reduced.

name: Ghangler Ignis
title: Longing in the Deep
description: Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey. Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once Ghangler Ignis sets its sights on them. In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full.

partnerSkill.name: Flame Lantern
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel quickly across water. While fighting together, the time it takes for Pals to bite during night fishing is reduced.

name: Rayhound
title: Electro-Charged Zoomies
description: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. If two Rayhounds collide, the sound is like that of a powerful thunderclap.

partnerSkill.name: Jumping Force
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
Can perform a double jump while mounted.

 This Pal's Movement Speed increases by 5% for each  Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Rayhound)

name: Rayhound Cryst
title: Frost-Fringed Zoomies
description: Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard, leading to constant Rayhound Cryst collisions due to zero visibility.

partnerSkill.name: Snow Shepherd
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden. 
Can perform a double jump while mounted.

 While in party, increases Defense of  Ice Pals by 15~30%. (Does not stack)

name: Menasting
title: Unstoppable Stinger
description: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Scorpion
partnerSkill.description: While in party, player's Defense increases by 5%, and  Electric Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

name: Menasting Terra
title: Gold-Piercing Spear
description: The main body is an entity made of energy, with nothing inside. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are stuck by it can only let out hellish groans.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Scorpion
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and Electric Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Needoll
title: Prickly Welcome
description: Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.

partnerSkill.name: Hug Me Please
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)

name: Needoll Noct
title: Binding Spines
description: Its spikes react to its emotions. A well-loved Needoll Noct clings to its owner, but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.

partnerSkill.name: Hug You So Much
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks increase Ivy-Covered buildup by (2~6). (Does not stack)

name: Reindrix
title: Frosthorn Beast
description: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen over and smashed to pieces.

partnerSkill.name: Cool Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Keeps the rider cool in hot environments.

name: Mossanda
title: Wanderer of the Forest
description: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this pal tore through 3,000 pieces of paper at once! It's only by some miracle this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

name: Mossanda Lux
title: Inheritor of the Storm
description: A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body, this Pal has been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

name: Chillet
title: Dancer on the Steppe
description: It can curl its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.

partnerSkill.name: Wriggling Weasel
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Dragon while mounted.

name: Chillet Ignis
title: Cherry Blossom Dancer
description: When curled up it spins so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, sparks fly!

partnerSkill.name: Sparkling Weasel
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Fire while mounted.

name: Ragnahawk
title: Wings of Inferno
description: Some think it is a related species to Beakon, but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.

partnerSkill.name: Flame Wing
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount. 

 While mounted, changes the player's attack type to  Fire and increases Attack by 5%.

name: Moldron
title: Scorched Wanderer
description: In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Overload
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a mount.
This Pal's Attack increases for each other  Fire or  Ground Pal in your party.

name: Moldron Cryst
title: Frigid Voyager
description: In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, abrupt death from shock.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Overload
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals'  Ice attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack)

name: Palumba
title: No Dance, No Life
description: Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance. In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses. Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance! Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?

partnerSkill.name: Samba Step
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Runs faster over grass.

name: Digtoise
title: Drilling Machine
description: A walking contradiction, possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it. "Digtoise's Fable" is a popular children's tale.

partnerSkill.name: Drill Crusher
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, enters the Shell Spin state. 

 Follows the player while spinning, increasing ore mining efficiency by 800%.

name: Broncherry
title: Winds of Spring
description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the "scent of first love."

partnerSkill.name: Love's First Blossom
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.

While in party,
Pal Eggs you pick up have a 35% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

name: Broncherry Aqua
title: Waves of Summer
description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the "perfume of purity"

partnerSkill.name: Overaffectionate
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a (45~55)% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

name: Dumud
title: Perpetual Procrastinator
description: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

partnerSkill.name: Soil Improver
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases Attack of  Ground Pals by 15%. 

 Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch.

name: Dumud Gild
title: Piece of Cake
description: Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud.

partnerSkill.name: Golden Harvest
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases the amount of Gold Coin dropped by enemies by +100~200%. 
Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch, with a small chance to drop Gold Coin. (Does not stack)

name: Braloha
title: Ancient Bloombringer
description: Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance that pollinates any plant it touches. For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.

partnerSkill.name: Balmy Weather
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While at a base, shortens the time it takes Pals assigned to BreedFarm to produce eggs. (Effect does not stack.)

name: Kitsun
title: Guardian of the Azure Flame
description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee to a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one were found nearby.

partnerSkill.name: Wolf of the Sun
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden. 

While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less  Ice damage and are immune to [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Status_Effects#Burn:~:text=Freeze,-%5Bedit Freeze]. (Does not stack)

name: Kitsun Noct
title: Guardian of the Dark Flame
description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun Noct is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. It has become quite gloomy from being a shut-in for too long.

partnerSkill.name: Fogged Mind
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Dark while mounted.

name: Blazehowl
title: Crimson Goliath
description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weapons- it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burred to a crisp.

partnerSkill.name: Hellflame Lion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, Grass Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Blazehowl Noct
title: Inferno Goliath
description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.

partnerSkill.name: Darkflame Lion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, Neutral Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Warsect
title: Unyielding Colossus
description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.

partnerSkill.name: Hard Armor
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and reduces damage received from Fire.

name: Warsect Terra
title: Golden Armor Warrior
description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. It doesn't flinch even if a Mammorest steps on it.

partnerSkill.name: Fortified Shell
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and reduces damage received from Fire.

name: Frostplume
title: Snowlaced Feather Mantle
description: So precise is its sense of time that it awakens at the exact same hour every morning. According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because when Frostplume spreads its tail feathers wide, it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.

partnerSkill.name: Peacock Pounce
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Frostplume's icy aura sharpens your focus, improving reload speed.

name: Majex
title: Flickering Shadow
description: It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.

partnerSkill.name: Phantasmal Arcana
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Status_Effects#Burn:~:text=Burn,-%5Bedit Burn], the enemy creates flames around itself, dealing continuous damage equal to 15% of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)

partnerSkill.name: Silk Maker
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Blizzard Spike. Sometimes produces High Quality Cloth when assigned to the ranch.

name: Sibelyx Primo
title: Gilded Lady
description: A Pal that loves gazing into the void, and will often remain completely still. It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals.

partnerSkill.name: Gilded Shroud
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of  Neutral Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.

name: Maraith
title: Messenger of Death
description: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.

partnerSkill.name: Messenger of Death
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden. 

While in party,
all Party Pals' Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by 30% whenever you defeat an enemy. (does not stack)

name: Shroomer
title: Creeping Mushroom
description: Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance. Sometimes, if Shroomer appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because it's high off its own spores.

partnerSkill.name: Rampant Spores
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Sometimes drops Mushroom or Cavern Mushroom when assigned to Ranch.

name: Shroomer Noct
title: Dangerous Mushroom
description: The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight. Sometimes, if Shroomer Noct appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.

partnerSkill.name: Roiling Spores
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While at a base, its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by 10%.

name: Icelyn
title: Icy Smile
description: Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing. Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much. If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath under a clear blue sky.

partnerSkill.name: Witch's Icy Veil
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Ice.

name: Gildra
title: Golden Blade of Duat
description: The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic. However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.

partnerSkill.name: Resurrection
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, when Gildra is incapacitated, it revives with its Hunger reduced to 0.

name: Jormuntide
title: Emperor of the Sea
description: Legend says that the Jormuntide was once a wise man, who after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to destroy those who wronged him.

partnerSkill.name: Stormbringer Sea Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, prevents stamina depletion while moving on water.

name: Jormuntide Ignis
title: Volcanic Emperor
description: Legend says the Jormuntide Ignis was once a warrior who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano, returned as this Pal to destroy those who wronged him.

partnerSkill.name: Stormbringer Lava Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.

name: Suzaku
title: Ruler of the Crimson Dawn
description: It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Flame
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.

name: Suzaku Aqua
title: Ruler of the Cobalt Dusk
description: It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. If there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Water
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Water attacks while mounted.

name: Dazemu
title: Brilliant Steps
description: Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Sprint
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Runs faster over sand.

name: Quivern
title: Snow-White Soarer
description: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.

partnerSkill.name: Sky Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. Enhances Dragon attacks while mounted.

name: Quivern Botan
title: Evergreen Flyer
description: When you hug Quivern Botan, if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.

partnerSkill.name: Grass Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. Enhances Grass attacks while mounted.

name: Lullu
title: Primal Source of Hay Fever
description: In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island. Flopie's hay fever is Lullu's fault.

partnerSkill.name: Floral Boost
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, Lullu fills the farm with good spirits, increasing the growth rate of the crops.

name: Kikit
title: Armored to the Teeth
description: A decade ago, Kikit soccer was popular. However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from the Free Pal Alliance. Nevertheless, the Kikits themselves didn't mind because it helped shed their old carapace.

partnerSkill.name: Rollin' Full Oil
partnerSkill.description: While in team, Kikit helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of crude oil in the player's inventory.

name: Yakumo
title: Unwavering Loyalty
description: It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumos are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.

partnerSkill.name: Birds of a Feather
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, it becomes easier to encounter pals with the same Passive Skill as this Pal. (Excludes certain Passive Skills)

name: Skutlass
title: Splashy Determined Draw
description: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

partnerSkill.name: Fish Fillet
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Skutlass becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2,600)

If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass will become incapacitated.

It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

name: Skutlass Ignis
title: Blazing Determined Draw
description: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

partnerSkill.name: Seared Fish Fillet
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Skutlass Ignis becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2,900~4,200).

 If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass Ignis will become incapacitated.

 It will also become incapacitated if Iagiri is used.

name: Reptyro
title: Lava-Devouring Juggernaut
description: Magma-like blood runs throughout its body. If a large amount of water is thrown on it, this water rapidly heats, causing an immense vapor explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Ore-Loving Beast
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
While in party,
reduces the weight of all types of ore by 30%.
(Does not stack)

name: Reptyro Cryst
title: Ice-Breaking Juggernaut
description: Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, causing an immense vapor explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Ice-Loving Beast
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden. 
While in party, reduces weight of ore by 35%. (Does not stack)

name: Starryon
title: Midnight Blue Mane
description:
It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane.
 If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly.
 Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids Azurmane at all costs.

partnerSkill.name: Night Dancer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Increases movement speed while mounted at night.

name: Starryon Primo
title: Silvermane
description: It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane. If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much, even by its favorite Pal Tamer.

partnerSkill.name: Light Dancer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other  Neutral Pal in your party. (Excluding Starryon Primo)

name: Pierdon
title: Shambling Vein
description: It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.

partnerSkill.name: Power Stone
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Muddy. (Does not stack)

name: Pierdon Cryst
title: Shuffling Glacier
description: It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape. Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.

partnerSkill.name: Power Crystal
partnerSkill.description: While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less  Dragon damage. (Does not stack)

name: Cryolinx
title: Predator of Snowy Peaks
description: It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Hunter
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Dragon Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Cryolinx Terra
title: Predator of the Earth
description: It can easily carry many items with its large hands. However, its short legs slow its pace, often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.

partnerSkill.name: Electro Hunter
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Electric Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Snugloo
title: Alpine Dwarf
description: “To look at a Snugloo's eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloos have eyes in the first place.

partnerSkill.name: Invisible Eye
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack)

name: Wumpo
title: Guardian of the Snowy Fields
description: Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Wumpo helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

name: Wumpo Botan
title: Guardian of the Grassy Fields
description: Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the South
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Wumpo Botan helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

name: Sootseer
title: Flickering Flame
description: It was once believed that as the world approached its end, the flame would weaken. Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken, but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by Sootseer. At least, for now.

partnerSkill.name: Grave Robber
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to the ranch.

name: Carnibora
title: Open-Minded Glutton
description: Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.

partnerSkill.name: Entangling Tongue
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals  Grass damage to enemies it touches. (Does not stack)

name: Blazamut
title: Cursed Tyrant
description: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.

name: Blazamut Ryu
title: Incarnation of the Eternal Flame
description: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Dragon attacks while mounted.

name: Dualith
title: Twinhearted Azure Construct
description: One entity, two minds. When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.

partnerSkill.name: Forest Laser
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
When activated, Dualith fires a powerful  Grass laser from its right hand.

name: Dualith Noct
title: Twinhearted Violet Construct
description: One entity, two minds. They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!

partnerSkill.name: Corruption Laser
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.

When activated, Dualith fires a powerful  Dark laser from its right hand.

name: Anubis
title: Guardian of the Dark Sun
description: Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this pal became a token of death.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Desert
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, applies  Ground damage to the player's attacks. Sometimes dodges attacks with a high speed sidestep while in battle.

name: Sekhmet
title: Cutthroat Sun Snuffer
description: Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility.

partnerSkill.name: Desert Empress
partnerSkill.description:
While at base, boosts Anubis's work speed.
Increases efficiency if Sekhmet is also working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)

name: Prixter
title: Bad Boy
description: It has about 5,000 types of poison. Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death, but all of them are too weak to have any effect.

partnerSkill.name: Phantom Venom
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Poison by 50%. (Does not stack)

name: Prixter Lux
title: Thunderboy
description: It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. However, the current it generates is extremely weak, so a simple punch would do far more damage.

partnerSkill.name: Scorpion Longwave
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Prixter Lux changes the player's attack type to  Electric and increases Attack by (30~50)%.

name: Tetroise
title: Sandsea Monolith
description: Those stones on its back are not just cargo. Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.

partnerSkill.name: Masonry Archelon
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.

While at a base, increases the Mining Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1.
(Does not stack)

name: Tetroise Primo
title: Sandsea Wardenstone
description: Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, Tetroise Primo will know where they are. No matter how far apart, it will always track them down.

partnerSkill.name: Stone-Chaser Archelon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces durability loss of all weapons and armor by (80~100)%. (Does not stack)

name: Nyafia
title: Night Shade Hunter
description:
Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye.
 If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears
 and ignore you for two weeks.

partnerSkill.name: Shot-Nyan Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time.

name: Mimog
title: Treasure Trove
description: There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for "being unaware of Mimog, opening the chest, and being bitten to death."

partnerSkill.name: Master of Unlocking
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Mimog can open treasure chests without using a key. Does not apply to chests that require a specific Work Suitability.

name: Xenovader
title: Interloper from Outer Space
description:
Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone.
- Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Meteor Mania
partnerSkill.description: While in the team, increases damage dealt to ores, and it's easier to obtain Meteorite Fragment.

name: Xenogard
title: Planet-Devouring Dragon
description:
Consumes information and turns it into energy. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone.
- Hello? What was the message you just sent? I devoured it before checking.

partnerSkill.name: Unknown Intruder
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.

While in party, increases the player's energy weapon damage by 10%. (Does not stack)

name: Prunelia
title: Indigo Handmaiden
description:
Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor,
 it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles.
 However, when encountered at night, its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.

partnerSkill.name: Prayer for Abundant Harvest
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, Prunelia's prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest.

name: Nitemary
title: Soul of the Dark Rabbit
description:
What it carries is its own soul.
 When it falls for someone,
 it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own,
 yearning to become one.

partnerSkill.name: Soul Collector
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Pals drop more Pal Souls when defeated.

name: Nitemary Botan
title: Soul of the Green Rabbit
description: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs, yearning to become one.

partnerSkill.name: Soul Binder
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of  Grass Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

name: Smokie
title: Jet-Black Little Hero
description:
The black flames are only warm to the touch,
 but anything that remains in contact with them slowly melts from the inside.
 Hold some cheese above them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

partnerSkill.name: Dig, Dog! Dig!
partnerSkill.description: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite. While fighting together, a large amount of Chromite is obtained.

name: Smokie Cryst
title: Chilly Little Hero
description: The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes. Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!

partnerSkill.name: Cryo Instincts
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Cooling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

name: Omascul
title: Hundred-Faced Apostle
description:
The mask it wears is not its face, they say.
 It seems in front, but it's not there, no way.
 From shadows deep, it watches night and day.
 Glance away, and closer it will stray.

partnerSkill.name: Masquerade Dance
partnerSkill.description: While in team, the Pals in the team gain more experience points.

name: Whalaska
title: Nice Ice Lance
description: When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.

partnerSkill.name: Chilled Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While fighting together, the fishing minigame  starts with the capture gauge higher than usual. Additionally, the capture gauge fills faster  when the bar is aligned.

name: Whalaska Ignis
title: Nice Crimson Lance
description: Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, it turned bright red through sheer will. Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red. So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.

partnerSkill.name: Cozy Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While fighting together, the fishing minigame  starts with the capture gauge higher than usual.  Additionally, the capture gauge fills faster  when the bar is aligned.

name: Verdash
title: Gale of the Forest
description: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing there soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.

partnerSkill.name: Grassland Speedster
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, increases player's movement speed and  changes the player's attack type to Grass.

name: Splatterina
title: Crimson Butcher
description:
It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart.
 Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment.
 If caught by Splatterina, pray that your head is taken first.

partnerSkill.name: Blade of Uncontrolled Passion
partnerSkill.description: While in possession, the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases.

name: Gildane
title: Guardian Beast of Twilight
description:
During the golden age of alchemy on the island,
 its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold.
 In time, a remarkable revelation was made:
 the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.

partnerSkill.name: Sandstorm's Blessing
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Ground while mounted.

name: Dogen
title: State of Enlightenment
description: Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects. It ate too much today.

partnerSkill.name: Homeward Prayer
partnerSkill.description: When activated, moves to the closest base. Cannot be used within dungeons, etc.

name: Bulldosu
title: Bangin' Yokozuna
description: In the old islands, Bulldosu sumo was widely enjoyed. At the highest levels, even a charging Rushoar would be sent flying instead.

partnerSkill.name: Yokozuna's Presence
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
While in party, player and party Pals take less  Electric damage and are immune to Electrify. (Does not stack)

name: Celesdir
title: Beast of Salvation
description:
Ancient texts refer to it as the "Beast of Salvation."
 The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything,
 literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Purification
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Increases the player's auto recovery speed while mounted.

name: Celesdir Noct
title: Beast of Chaos
description: Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born. It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be. Balance is what the world requires.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Chaos
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for (40~80)% Attack increase. (Does not stack)

name: Astegon
title: Monarch of the Steel Dragon
description: A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.

partnerSkill.name: Black Ankylosaur
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases the damage dealt to ores, and you can obtain more Ore while mounted.

alphaDrops.item: Heat Resistant Refined Metal Armor Schematic 4

name: Knocklem
title: Suit of Armor
description: Can be disassembled into 215 parts, and even if the parts are scattered, it will reassemble itself and start moving again. If parts from different individuals are mixed it will malfunction due to mistaken identity.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Guardian Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem's Attack and Defense for a limited time.

name: Knocklem Ignis
title: Blazing Suit of Armor
description: Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat.

partnerSkill.name: Iron Guardian Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem Ignis's Attack by (60~210)% and Defense by (60~210)% for a limited time.

name: Silvegis
title: Guardian Dragon of Ironclad
description:
The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties.
 If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it.
 When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning,
 and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.

partnerSkill.name: Aegis Shield
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Increases the duration of the shield when using Aegis Charge while mounted.

name: Azurmane
title: Blue Lightning Steed
description:
Like Univolt, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God.
 As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God's true envoy.
 Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.

partnerSkill.name: Plasma Dash
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Also allows dashing in the air and moving at high speed.

name: Valentail
title: Plays Both Sides
description: In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century.

partnerSkill.name: Big Stretch
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling.(Does not stack)

name: Snock
title: Sluggish Blue Bolt
description: Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.

partnerSkill.name: Charging Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Electrify. (Does not stack)

name: Snock Terra
title: Sluggish Dazzling Flash
description: Tossing a heated Snock Terra into the bath for a scorching spa was once a fad of the distant past. Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.

partnerSkill.name: Grounding Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in party, >player and party Pals take (15~30)% less  Water damage, and are immune to Soak. (Does not stack)

name: Souffline
title: Windborne Seedling
description: Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.

partnerSkill.name: Fuzzy Fairy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)

name: Lapiron
title: Indomitable Racer
description: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.

partnerSkill.name: Friend of Earth
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's Defense while sprinting. (Does not stack)

name: Hoodle
title: Vanishing Master
description: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.

partnerSkill.name: Void-Dweller
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat. (Does not stack)

name: Slowatt
title: Shockingly Laid-Back
description: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.

partnerSkill.name: Chillswitch
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify, the enemy discharges electricity, dealing damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

name: Bakemi
title: Freakily Cute
description: It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening. As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness, Bakemi now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.

partnerSkill.name: Grinning Death
partnerSkill.description: While in party, attacking enemies afflicted with Poison reduces their Attack. (Does not stack)

name: Solmora
title: Buoyant Baron
description: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.

partnerSkill.name: Charming Fish
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water.
While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)

name: Solmora Lux
title: Buoyant Brigadier
description: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power.

partnerSkill.name: Shocking Fish
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water.

While mounted,
changes the player's attack type to  Electric and increases Attack by 5%.

While in party,
Makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)

name: Lapure
title: Pristine Fisticuffs
description: It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.

partnerSkill.name: Long-Sleeved Hurray
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals. (Does not stack)

name: Eidrolon
title: Wings of Freedom
description: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. It is no longer bound by anything.

partnerSkill.name: Liberated Pterosaur
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount.
This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase for each other  Dragon or  Dark Pal in your party.

name: Eidrolon Ignis
title: Wings of Distrust
description: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target.

partnerSkill.name: Resentful Pterosaur
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount.

This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increases by (2~6)% for each other  Dragon or  Fire Pal in your party.
(Excluding Eidrolon Ignis)

name: Dynamoff
title: Buzzy Bundle
description: With so little to eat at high altitudes, it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains. It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into Beakon.

partnerSkill.name: Electro-Massage Incubation
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs. (Does not stack)

name: Tropicaw
title: Blooming Crooner
description: While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers swaying in the wind and avoid predators, others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.

partnerSkill.name: Flower Dance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps. (Does not stack)

name: Flaracle
title: Self-Serving Seer
description: It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames. Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result. That is why the future of Flaracle is always exceptionally bright!

partnerSkill.name: Burning Future
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy explodes, dealing damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

name: Ophydia
title: Pure Bloom Dragon
description: Waters where Ophydias dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.

partnerSkill.name: Glorious Mist
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Soak. (Does not stack)

name: Dupin
title: Illusionist Cottontail
description: A copy it created might quietly replace it, leaving even the Dupin itself unsure whether it is still the original.

partnerSkill.name: Trick-Loving Fluffle
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player's Health falls below 50%, Dupin generates an explosion around the player. Additionally, while the player's Health is below 50%, the player's Attack is increased. (Does not stack)

name: Roujay
title: Pitch Black Pilferer
description: A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking. No reason to be concerned when caught in the act. Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.

partnerSkill.name: Dark-Nester
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Blind. (Does not stack)

name: Venusa
title: Salon Shunner
description: Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head. However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.

partnerSkill.name: Snake's Sagacity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Status_Effects#Blind:~:text=Blind,-%5Bedit Blind]. (Does not stack)

name: Mycora
title: Cute as a Button
description: It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts. The reason Mycora has taken this form is to deceive humans into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.

partnerSkill.name: Charming Spore
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Medicine Production Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals. (Does not stack)

name: Loomen
title: Revealer of Truths
description: Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world. If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.

partnerSkill.name: Lantern Enchantment
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's arrows explode on contact, dealing additional damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack)

name: Wistella
title: Mantle of the Night
description: At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, glowing with the weight of its memories.

partnerSkill.name: Hidden Dark Energy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Defense of  Dark Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

name: Solenne
title: Veiled Dancer of Dusk
description: Joy and misery come in equal measure for Solenne. Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.

partnerSkill.name: Untainted Maiden
partnerSkill.description: While in the party, increases the player's Attack in party of different Pal species.

name: Renjishi
title: Scorching Ovation
description: At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings. Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, and become unable to look away, as if transfixed.

partnerSkill.name: Stage Combat
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, the player's attacks inflict Burn 2~6.
(Does not stack)

name: Aegidron
title: Guardian of Luminous Trails
description: In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, the light within Aegidron's wings was used to send simple flash signals.

partnerSkill.name: Insestructible Fortress
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.

While in party, player and party Pals take 60% less damage from explosive attacks, and are immune to Stun. (Does not stack)

name: Grizzbolt
title: Claws of Lightning
description: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun.

partnerSkill.name: Yellow Tank
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted.

name: Lyleen
title: Lily Empress
description: A docile Pal full of love. It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. It uses a full-power Solar Blast to discipline naughty Pals.

partnerSkill.name: Harvest Goddess
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  the queen's soothing graces greatly restore the player's Health.

name: Lyleen Noct
title: Empress of the Abyss
description: An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.

partnerSkill.name: Goddess of the Tranquil Light
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  the queen's soothing graces greatly restore the player's Health.

alphaDrops.item: Cold Resistant Refined Metal Armor Schematic 4

name: Orserk
title: Roaring Thunder
description: It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye.

partnerSkill.name: Ferocious Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.description: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by 1% for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack)

name: Faleris
title: Sentinel of Dawn
description: When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.

partnerSkill.name: Scorching Predator
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While fighting together, Ice Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Faleris Aqua
title: Sentinel of the Tides
description: When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area. More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.

partnerSkill.name: Tidal Predator
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While fighting together, Fire Pals drop more items when defeated.

name: Shadowbeak
title: Unknown Life Form
description: Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence should not be. Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Modified DNA
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. Enhances Dark attacks by 15% - 30% while mounted.

name: Selyne
title: Crescent of the Darkest Night
description: The object floating behind, resembling the moon, is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation. No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.

partnerSkill.name: Celestial Darkness
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Neutral and Dark attacks while mounted.

name: Bastigor
title: King of Frostfang
description:
The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it.
 For Bastigor the toughest challenge, after simply living,
 is making a snowman.

partnerSkill.name: Blizzard Crash
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with an Ice-forged hammer.

name: Shaolong
title: Water God
description: Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership

partnerSkill.name: Azure Sovreign
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack increases by (4~8)% for each other  Dragon Pal in your party.

name: Silvance
title: Immortal Shade
description:
Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil.
What it protects, or for what purpose, Silvance does not know.
After all, the World Tree will tell it everything.
The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is.

partnerSkill.name: Spore Stalwart
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Ivy-Covered, the enemy explodes, dealing additional damage equal to 40% of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack)

Also grants immunity to the World Tree's Explosive Spores to both the player ahd their Pals.

name: Dandilord
title: Bewitching Lurker
description:
Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil.
What it protects, and for what purpose, Dandilord does not care.
After all, the World Tree knows everything.
Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.

partnerSkill.name: Mist Stalwart
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, the player's attacks increase Poison buildup by 2.

While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Poison, and nullifies the effects of toxic gas in the World Tree area. (Does not stack)

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Iris
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Nightmare Ray.

name: Bellanoir Libero
title: Twilight Siren
description: With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. she longed for a self to gaze upon herself. And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Stare
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Nightmare Bloom.

name: Xenolord
title: Invader from Space
description: -Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity |Supersonic Dragon| -Note: Conquest deadline exceeded by  years. -Update: No conquest traces found. Naturalization confirmed. Commence elimination protocol. -Staff Memo: Refrain from forgetting or consuming critical data!

partnerSkill.name: Meteor Wings
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, damage done by Partner Skills of weapon-wielding Pals increases by 20%. (Does not stack

name: Hartalis
title: King of Salvation
description: The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing. No one else remains. All have been delivered. O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness. -The ancient text cuts off here.

partnerSkill.name: Sacred Barrier
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, generates a barrier that blocks all attacks. Can triple jump while mounted.

name: Paladius
title: Holy Knight of Legend
description: Once one with Necromus. Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions. However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Holy Knight of the Firmament
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can triple jump while mounted.

alphaDrops.item: Cold Resistant Pal Metal Armor Schematic 4

name: Necromus
title: Dark Knight of Legend
description: Once one with Paladius. Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knight of the Abyss
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

alphaDrops.item: Heat Resistant Pal Metal Armor Schematic 4

name: Frostallion
title: Legendary Steed of Ice
description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into an eternal winter.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Steed
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Ice and enhances Ice attacks while mounted.

name: Frostallion Noct
title: Legendary Steed of Darkness
description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Steed
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dark, increases Attack by (10~40)%, and apply Blind buildup by (2~6).

name: Neptilius
title: Legend of the Seas
description: After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.

partnerSkill.name: Sentinel of the Great Sea
partnerSkill.description: While in party, it follows up the player's attacks with  Water spear strikes. Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, it can leap high into the air over water.

name: Jetragon
title: Legendary Celestial Dragon
description: Watches over Palpagos Island from high above. When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, and the skies will burn. It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Missile
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

name: Panthalus
title: Legendary Ocean King
description: The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart. Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.

partnerSkill.name: Resonant Guardian
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above.

name: Astralym
title: |ele1 =
description:
A shadow of its former self, this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago. Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer.

I never wanted to hurt anyone. I just wanted to be together, just wanted to be there. But because that was forbidden... because they wouldn't forgive us... I decided I wanted a world for just the two of us.
